topic.name: 膜厚写出的明暗
topic.title: 肥皂膜与劈尖的条纹为什么移动？
topic.question: 肥皂膜与劈尖的条纹为什么移动？
topic.description: 保留黄光灯、肥皂膜和纸片劈尖，计算反射相位与条纹。

zh: 肥皂膜与劈尖的条纹为什么移动？
en: Why do soap-film and wedge fringes move?

translations.肥皂膜与劈尖的条纹为什么移动？: Why do soap-film and wedge fringes move?
translations.保留黄光灯、肥皂膜和纸片劈尖，计算反射相位与条纹。: Follow reflected phase through a yellow-lit soap film and a paper-spaced air wedge.

cues.title: 先用黄光看膜的反射像
cues.caption: 同一膜上的不同厚度，对同一波长给出不同明暗。
cues.captionEn: Different thicknesses produce different brightness for the same wavelength.
cues.zh: 教材先在酒精灯灯芯撒盐，用黄色火焰照明，把肥皂膜当作镜面观察反射像。膜前后两面反射的光会叠加，因此同一片膜上出现明暗条纹。画面把正视反射像展开；左侧灯和铁丝圈表示装置关系，并不是严格的成像透视图。下方比较两束反射光的相位。
cues.en: The textbook starts with a salt-yellowed alcohol flame reflected by a soap film. Light reflected from both film surfaces interferes, producing bright and dark bands. The front-facing film display unfolds the reflected view; the lamp and wire loop identify the apparatus rather than a perspective image. Below, compare the reflected phases.

cues.title: 膜变薄，条纹会移动
cues.caption: 位置改变的是等光程差的厚度轮廓。
cues.captionEn: Contours of equal optical path difference move as thickness changes.
cues.zh: 重力排液会让竖直肥皂膜的厚度随高度和时间变化。页面改变一个简化的厚度分布，看同一明条纹移到新的位置。前表面反射还会发生半周相位变化，所以膜厚趋近零时反射变暗。厚度的变化是教学输入，不是完整求解肥皂液流动；真实膜还会受表面活性剂和空气扰动影响。
cues.en: Drainage changes a vertical soap film’s thickness with height and time. Vary a prescribed thickness profile and watch equal-phase contours move. The front reflection adds a half-cycle shift, making a nearly zero-thickness film dark. Thickness evolution is a teaching input, not a fluid simulation including surfactants and air disturbances.

cues.title: 换成白光，比较不同波长
cues.caption: 不同波长的明条纹不在同一位置。
cues.captionEn: Different wavelengths brighten at different positions.
cues.zh: 换成白光后，不同波长在同一厚度处有不同的相位差。某些颜色增强，另一些颜色减弱，于是出现彩色条纹。画面只用红绿蓝三个采样波长近似显示颜色，不把这些颜色当作真实光谱测量。自由探索中可以回到单色光，改变波长并追踪条纹的位置。
cues.en: Under white illumination, different wavelengths have different phase differences at the same thickness. Some strengthen while others weaken, producing color. Three sampled wavelengths provide an illustrative display, not a measured spectrum or calibrated color prediction. Exploration returns to monochromatic light so you can move the fringes by changing wavelength.

cues.title: 用两张纸片支起空气劈尖
cues.titleEn: Support an air wedge with two sheets
cues.caption: 等厚度位置形成平行条纹，接触端为暗纹。
cues.captionEn: Equal-thickness contours form parallel bands; the contact is dark.
cues.zh: 两块平玻璃一端接触，另一端夹入两张相同纸片，形成线性变厚的空气层。来自空气层上下边界的反射光叠加，接触端出现暗纹。侧视图把夹角放大，上方只展开靠近接触端的前四毫米，这样能看清条纹；它不是整块玻璃上的条纹总数。
cues.en: Two glass plates touch at one end and are separated by two identical paper sheets at the other. Reflection from the air-gap boundaries forms parallel fringes, with a dark contact. The side-view angle is enlarged. Above, only the first four millimeters near contact are shown, not all fringes across the entire plate.

cues.title: 抽掉一张，条纹间距加倍
cues.titleEn: Remove one sheet to double fringe spacing
cues.caption: 空气层厚度斜率减半，同一厚度差需要两倍距离。
cues.captionEn: Half the thickness gradient requires twice the distance for the same thickness change.
cues.zh: 抽去一张纸片后，支撑厚度减半，玻璃长度不变。相邻同类条纹对应的厚度差仍然是半个空气中波长，因此水平间距加倍。模型只比较支撑后的静态状态，过渡表示上板落到新的位置，不计算纸片抽动和玻璃弹性。改变支撑不会把波长也改变。
cues.en: After removing one sheet, support thickness halves while plate length remains fixed. Neighboring like fringes still differ in thickness by half a wavelength in air, so their horizontal spacing doubles. The model compares static supported states; the transition indicates settling, not paper friction or glass elasticity. Wavelength does not change.
